# D.R. Horton

> > America's largest homebuilder offering new homes for sale across the United States with smart home technology, multiple home series, and comprehensive financing options including FHA, VA, and ARM loans.

D.R. Horton specializes in building and selling new construction homes through various product lines including the Tradition Series and America's Smart Home program. The company provides integrated mortgage services through DHI Mortgage and offers special benefits for military homebuyers.
